items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And my name is Dick Allen, and you got a name too, huh? [INTERVIEWEE] My name is Sabina Franco.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Ernie Cagnoletti, yeah. Yeah, Cagnoletti. On trumpet. Uh-huh. Yeah. Are you going to continue on with this Young Tuxedo Orchestra? You going to use that name?
Mm-hmm. I'm going to try to hold it as long as I can, Dick. Mm-hmm. I'm going to change it. I don't have no reason for changing it.

items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: That's why whenever he be making them talks he said well Tillman is part of the cause I'm here in Yorlin. He encouraged me to come down here. ... He did a whole lot of good things for me.

ctx.x: Your band was Joe Angry was up at the buzzards club there on the enunciation or someplace?

Joe Well yeah we played for the buzzards so a lot for about it. The first club we played yeah we played for the buzzards we played for the Eleanor's. We played for the Lions and we used to play up in Audubon Park at Tyler's. You ever heard of Tyler's? Joe Oh yeah. Joe Well that's the first place I met Dick Allen. I was playing at Tyler's. Joe And I encouraged Dick to come here he was in the service thing you know. He had us to make a little cut for him. We had.
I remember he made a tape of that.
